official_options.how: The official 2027 regulations describe priority for people who were on the 2026 waiting list and say they may register during a second four-day loyalty period (April 11–14, 2026), if they did not get a place through the 2026 waitlist. The supplied official information does not establish that a new waitlist for the 2027 race is currently open.
No official bib resale or exchange platform is identified in the supplied organiser FAQ or regulations; its existence cannot be confirmed from these materials.

The supplied official materials do not explicitly state whether a 2027 registration can be transferred to another runner. They do not provide a transfer procedure, so transfer permission cannot be confirmed.
